title: Product Management: production overview
description: Traffic, errors, latency and microcache from the gateway's access log; API, PostgreSQL and Redis logs; one request by trace_id. Logs only (Loki). See docs/guide/08-observability.md.

options.content: **Production overview**, computed from logs only (Loki). Traffic, errors, latency and the microcache come from the gateway's access log (one JSON line per request); errors from the API's JSON logs; the database and cache from their servers' logs. The **URIs** variable chooses API calls only (default) or every request (web app files included). To follow one request, paste its `trace_id` in the **trace_id** box and open the last row. Runbooks for every alert: `docs/guide/08-observability.md`.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Average requests per second through the gateway in the range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status!="" [$__range])) / $__range_s

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of answers with a 5xx status. Alert GatewayHighErrorRate: above 2 % for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status=~"5.." [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time nginx took to answer (token check, microcache, API). Alert GatewayHighLatency: above 500 ms for 10 minutes.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | unwrap duration [$__range]) by ()

panels.title: Microcache hit ratio
panels.description: API GETs answered by the gateway's 1-second microcache without reaching the API.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | method="GET" | cache="HIT" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | method="GET" | cache!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: API errors
panels.description: API log lines at Error or Critical in the range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="api", level=~"Error|Critical"} [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Slow SQL statements
panels.description: PostgreSQL statements slower than 250 ms (log_min_duration_statement) in the range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |= "duration:" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests/s by status class
panels.description: Every answer of the gateway by class: 2xx success, 3xx (web app), 4xx client errors, 5xx server errors.

targets.expr: sum by (class) (rate({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status!="" | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .status }}xx` [$__auto]))

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of answers with a 5xx status: 502/504 = no API replica answered in time, 500/503 = the API failed or a dependency is down. Dashed line: the 2 % alert threshold.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status=~"5.." [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status!="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: 4xx by status
panels.description: 401 = missing, forged or expired token (rejected at the gateway); 404 = unknown product; 409 = not enough stock or a duplicate request in flight; 412 = edit based on an old version; 429 = rate limited (gateway per-IP limit or the API's limiter); 499 = the client gave up.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (rate({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status=~"4.." [$__auto]))

panels.title: Requests/s by route
panels.description: Requests per method and path, with numeric ids replaced by {id} and the query string removed. Top 10.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (method, path) (rate({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | status!="" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+" (regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .uri "") "/{id}" }}` [$__auto])))

panels.title: Requests by user (top 10)
panels.description: Requests per verified token subject (the client id). Anonymous requests (sign-in, web app files) have no user.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user) (count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | user!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Errors by user (4xx + 5xx)
panels.description: Which client gets the errors: a single user with many 401 or 429 is a client problem, not a system one.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (user, status) (rate({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | user!="" | status=~"[45].." [$__auto])))

panels.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Total time nginx took to answer (token check, microcache, waiting for and running the API). Dashed line: the 500 ms alert threshold for p95.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | unwrap duration [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | unwrap duration [$__auto]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.99, {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | unwrap duration [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: Which route is slow (top 8 by p95). Long tails on writes usually mean waits on row locks or on a free database connection.

targets.expr: topk(8, quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+" (regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .uri "") "/{id}" }}` | unwrap duration [$__auto]) by (method, path))

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95 over the range)
panels.description: p95 and request count per method and path, slowest first.

targets.expr: topk(15, quantile_over_time(0.95, {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+" (regexReplaceAll "\\?.*" .uri "") "/{id}" }}` | unwrap duration [$__range]) by (method, path))

panels.title: Microcache answers (API GETs)
panels.description: HIT = answered by nginx without reaching the API; MISS/EXPIRED = forwarded; BYPASS = the client asked for fresh data (Cache-Control: no-cache); UPDATING = served stale while one request refreshes it.

targets.expr: sum by (cache) (rate({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | method="GET" | cache!="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Microcache hit ratio
panels.description: HIT / all cacheable API GETs.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | method="GET" | cache="HIT" [$__auto])) or vector(0)) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | json uri, method, cache, duration | __error__="" | uri=~"$uri" | method="GET" | cache!="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: API warnings and errors by category
panels.description: API log lines at Warning and above, by logger category. Warnings from RedisCatalogCache or RedisDistributedRateLimiter mean Redis is slow or unreachable and the API is falling back to PostgreSQL / per-replica limits; HealthChecks errors mean a dependency failed its check.

targets.expr: sum by (level, category) (count_over_time({namespace="product-management", app="api", level=~"Warning|Error|Critical"} [$__auto]))

panels.title: API errors
panels.description: API lines at Error or Critical, with the exception. Expand a line: the trace_id field links to every log line of the same request.

targets.expr: {namespace="product-management", app="api", level=~"Error|Critical"} | json Category="Category", Message="Message", Exception="Exception" | line_format `{{.Category}}: {{.Message}} {{.Exception}}`

panels.title: Gateway errors
panels.description: 5xx answers, and nginx's own error-log lines (upstream timeouts, refused connections, token-key fetch failures).

targets.expr: {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} |~ `"status":5[0-9][0-9]|\[(error|crit|alert|emerg)\]`

panels.title: Slow statements, lock waits, errors
panels.description: Per minute: statements slower than 250 ms; lock waits longer than deadlock_timeout (1 s) and deadlocks; ERROR lines (failed statements, cancellations); FATAL/PANIC (refused or lost connections, crashes).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |= "duration:" [1m]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |~ "still waiting for|deadlock detected" [1m]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |~ "ERROR:" [1m]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |~ "FATAL:|PANIC:" [1m]))

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Checkpoints started per minute, by trigger. 'wal' checkpoints closer than 30 s apart mean max_wal_size is too small for the write rate (PostgreSQL also logs a hint).

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |= "checkpoint starting" | regexp `checkpoint starting: (?P<reason>.+)` [5m]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |= "checkpoints are occurring too frequently" [5m]))

panels.title: Slowest statements (range)
panels.description: Longest duration per statement (first line of the statement text), from PostgreSQL's slow-statement log.

targets.expr: topk(15, max_over_time({namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |= "duration:" | regexp `duration: (?P<ms>[0-9.]+) ms\s+(?:statement|execute|bind|parse)[^:]*: (?P<stmt>.{0,120})` | unwrap ms [$__range]) by (stmt))

panels.title: PostgreSQL warnings and errors
panels.description: Slow statements, lock waits, deadlocks, errors and fatal lines, newest first.

targets.expr: {namespace="servers", app="postgres"} |~ `duration:|still waiting for|deadlock|ERROR:|FATAL:|PANIC:|WARNING:|HINT:`

panels.title: Redis warnings
panels.description: Redis log lines at warning level ('#') and persistence/configuration errors (MISCONF, failed saves). Normally none: Redis is quiet unless something is wrong.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="servers", app="redis"} |~ " [0-9:.]12 # |MISCONF|Can.t save|Background saving error|Failed opening" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Redis log
panels.description: Every Redis log line (start-up, configuration, warnings).

targets.expr: {namespace="servers", app="redis"}

panels.title: Follow one request (paste a trace_id above)
1. Gateway access log
panels.description: The gateway's line for the request: status, total and upstream time, which API replica answered, microcache status, the verified user.

targets.expr: {namespace="product-management", app="gateway"} | trace_id="$trace_id" | trace_id!="" | json | line_format `{{.status}} {{.method}} {{.uri}}  {{.duration}}s  upstream={{.upstream}} ({{.upstream_duration}}s)  cache={{.cache}}  user={{.user}}`

panels.title: 2. API logs
panels.description: Every line the API wrote while handling the request (same trace_id), whichever replica.

targets.expr: {namespace="product-management", app="api"} | trace_id="$trace_id" | trace_id!="" | json LogLevel="LogLevel", Category="Category", Message="Message", Exception="Exception" | line_format `{{.LogLevel}} {{.Category}}: {{.Message}} {{.Exception}}`
